summary: The revision resolves four prior blockers. Candidate acceptance and demo expiry remain blocked by contract contradictions.

blocking_findings.summary: The plan still cannot guarantee authenticated acceptance before a traffic shift.
blocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:88-92 names preview origins and a callback-origin handoff. plan.md:84-120 has no Red test for a preview start handoff. plan.md:138-166 has no explicit handoff implementation. Both cloudbuild.yaml files promote immediately after their candidate checks. spec.md:135-136 permits only Marketing preview-origin wiring, while plan.md:183-187 requires browser acceptance before promotion.

blocking_findings.summary: The expiry contract cannot expire the no-role identity as written.
blocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:113-118 and plan.md:70-77 require three identities, including one no-role identity. They require every identity to expire through role expiry. packages/db/src/company-identity/schema/index.ts:428-482 places expiresAt only on role assignments. A no-role identity has no role assignment to expire.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The Sales legacy redirect target remains unnamed.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:129-132 and plan.md:49-52 require a redirect to the legacy sign-in path. plan.md:100-103 tests that phrase without an exact path. Sales has no login page route; the legacy form renders on app/[locale]/page.tsx.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The Sales session denial response has no exact contract.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:105-109 and plan.md:62-66 require an explicit denial state. plan.md:100-105 does not define its status code or response body. The current route returns HTTP 200 with session null.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The draft still overstates Codecamp origin parity.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:84-87 and plan.md:37-40 reject the forwarded origin and use the configured origin. Codecamp public-url.ts:146 throws PUBLIC_ORIGIN_INVALID instead of using a fallback.

evidence: RA-A-R2-1 is resolved. spec.md:32 and 129-132 use company and legacy-school. plan.md:49-52, 98, 102, 152, and 177 add the start gate and legacy test coverage. auth-mode.ts:2,13-16 confirms both valid values.

RA-A-R2-2 is resolved. spec.md:105-109 requires both the callback redirect and the session denial. plan.md:62-66, 104-105, and 154-155 require both behaviors. Acceptance at spec.md:155 requires the visible forbidden message.
RA-A-R2-3 is not resolved. The draft adds both preview variables and both cloudbuild files to the blast radius. It does not add the required handoff test, implementation, or pre-promotion gate.
RA-A-R2-4 is partly resolved. spec.md:113-121 and plan.md:70-77 add at least 24 random bytes, a 90-day limit, disable, and rotation. RA-A-R3-2 records the remaining no-role expiry contradiction.

RA-A-R2-6 is resolved. No Sales runbook exists. plan.md:188-190 now creates apps/sales-advantage/docs/sales-sso-deploy-runbook-20260829.md.
RA-A-R2-8 is resolved. spec.md:127-128, plan.md:119, and plan.md:165 cover Marketing early-return cookie expiry.
